description: Implement core HTTP routing infrastructure: route registration with path parameter extraction, ctx object with params/form/query/headers/file/session, response helpers (render stub, redirect, explicit response), group auth propagation, static file serving with gzip, embedded HTMX, error handling (auto-404, custom error pages, 500), and CORS denial. This is the main runtime module for Phase 3.
steps: Create src/doot/router.nim: Route type (method, path pattern, handler proc, auth requirement, role requirement), RouteTable type (seq of Route), path matching with parameter extraction (split path on '/', match static segments exactly, capture :param segments), route ordering (static before parameterized, more segments before fewer), method matching (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH)

Create src/doot/ctx.nim: DootCtx object type with fields: params (Table[string,string] for path params), form (Table[string,string] for POST form data), query (Table[string,string] for query string), headers (Table[string,string] for request headers), file (Table[string,UploadedFile] for file uploads), session (DootSession object with get/set/delete procs backed by SQLite), currentUser (Option[Row] from db_types). Include parseQueryString, parseFormData, parseMultipartFormData helper procs.

Create src/doot/response.nim: DootResponse type (status: int, headers: Table[string,string], body: string), renderResponse proc (stub that returns the template path as placeholder HTML in a 200 response with Content-Type: text/html), redirectResponse proc (returns 302 with Location header), explicitResponse proc (custom status/body/content-type), errorResponse proc (404/500 with default styled HTML or custom error page content)

Create src/doot/static_files.nim: serveStaticFile proc that reads from a given static/ directory, maps file extension to content-type (html, css, js, png, jpg, gif, svg, ico, woff, woff2, json, xml, txt), applies gzip compression (using std/zlib or zopfli), sets Cache-Control headers (max-age=3600 default), returns DootResponse. Include MIME type mapping table.

Create src/doot/htmx.nim: embed the HTMX library as a const string in the binary (download htmx.min.js content or use a representative minified stub), serve from path /__doot/htmx.min.js with Content-Type: application/javascript, gzip compression, and long cache headers (max-age=31536000 immutable).

Create src/doot/error_pages.nim: defaultErrorPage proc that generates styled HTML for 404/500 errors (simple clean design with error code and message), customErrorPage proc that checks for views/errors/404.do or views/errors/500.do existence and returns their content (stub rendering for Phase 3). Auto-404 logic: a helper proc autoFind that wraps db find and raises a Http404 exception (or returns a sentinel) when result is None.

Create src/doot/cors.nim: CorsConfig type (allowed origins, methods, headers), corsMiddleware proc that checks Origin header against config, returns 403 with empty body if CORS not allowed, adds Access-Control-Allow-* headers if allowed. Default config: empty (deny all cross-origin). parseCorsConfig proc for future use with config block.

Create src/doot/server.nim: Main HTTP server module that ties everything together. Uses mummy (or fallback). Creates a mummy Router, registers all routes from RouteTable, adds static file handler for /static/* paths, adds HTMX handler for /__doot/htmx.min.js, creates DootCtx for each request, applies CORS middleware, applies auth check (stub: just check if route requires auth, return 401 if no session), dispatches to handler, catches exceptions for 500 responses. startServer proc takes port and RouteTable.

Create src/doot/session.nim: DootSession type backed by SQLite. Session table schema (session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT as JSON, user_id INTEGER, expires_at TEXT, created_at TEXT). Procs: createSessionTable (auto-create on startup), getSession (by session ID from cookie), setSessionValue, getSessionValue, deleteSessionValue. Session ID generation (random hex string). Cookie signing is a stub for Phase 3 (just use plain session ID - Phase 5 adds HMAC signing).
Update doot.nimble to add the new test file entries to the test task
Ensure all modules compile cleanly with --threads:on --mm:orc flags
acceptance_criteria: Route matching correctly dispatches GET /posts to static route handler
Route matching correctly extracts :id from /posts/:id path
Route matching correctly extracts multiple params from /users/:user_id/posts/:id
Static routes are matched before parameterized routes
ctx.params, ctx.form, ctx.query, ctx.headers are populated correctly from request
render 'posts/index', posts: posts returns a 200 response with stub HTML mentioning the template path
redirect '/posts' returns a 302 response with Location: /posts header
Static files are served from static/ with correct content-type headers
HTMX is served from /__doot/htmx.min.js with application/javascript content-type
db.find returning None triggers a 404 response via auto-404 mechanism
Default error pages have styled HTML with error code
Group auth: required propagates to enclosed routes
Routes without explicit auth annotation default to auth: required
CORS is denied by default (cross-origin requests get 403)
Unhandled exceptions in handlers produce a 500 response
verification: Run: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --threads:on --mm:orc --hints:off src/doot/server.nim (compiles without error)
Run: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --threads:on --mm:orc --hints:off -r tests/test_router.nim (all route matching tests pass)

Run all existing tests to confirm no regressions: nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_lexer.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_parser.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_integration.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_schema.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_query.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_migrations.nim
